fix(woodii): restore hidden match-device route

Summary:
- add a frontend node migration for the camellia match-device page
- keep the page hidden from menus while exposing /app/universal/match-device
- require frontend-node authorization on the hidden route

Rationale:
- the page and CRUD API already exist in woodii, but no frontend node seeded
  the route, so permission-driven menus could not emit it
- a hidden node preserves the off-menu operating model without expanding scope
  into unrelated page or menu refactors

Tests:
- cd woodii && npm exec --package yarn@1.22.22 -- yarn install --frozen-lockfile
  && npm exec --package yarn@1.22.22 -- yarn build:dev
- node route-resolution replay confirmed
  /app/universal/match-device -> @views/app/universal/match-device.vue
